method: Read-only original AC/source/recorded-unit/raw-browser/simulation audit. No tests or browsers started for this audit. Two separately authorized stale-spec maintenance edits were made and typechecked, but their future full-suite outcome is not assumed.

definitions.proven: Current source+recorded C execution proves technical clauses at stated scope; no human inference.
definitions.partial: A clause, exact scenario, current-version UI/native path or human outcome remains open.
definitions.missing: Required outcome has no evidence; especially human cognition cannot be inferred from UI/tests.
definitions.contradicted: Direct current source permits a behavior or statement contrary to the explicit requirement; no new execution claimed.

growth.fact: Seed/history/equipment produce three distinct legal options; opening guarantees usable Beacon and Chain, later drafts guarantee an owned upgrade.

reward.fact: Independent reward keys, diminishing ordinary rewards, event-driven XP thresholds and separate starter debt.

commit.fact: Run/draft/option validation, explicit replacement confirmation, cleanup and independent carrying set update only after commit.

cleanup.fact: Replacing a protocol clears its marks, cells, resonance or charge; there are no per-protocol subscriptions.

chain.fact: Recent history uses selected/planned hop count before the host damage acceptance; not the stricter runMetrics count.

protocols.fact: Four protocols, three slots, 20/55/95/150/220 XP, three-hop cap and 128-command budget.

hud.fact: Combat counts use accepted metrics; trace applications are labeled separately.

pause.fact: Pause ownership continues through queued drafts and resumes only after resolution.

input.fact: Browser blur clears held input and invokes pause; source existence is not physical OS focus evidence.

pulse.fact: Actual E pulse uses sector/LOS, tissue cost, cooldown and active-world collision projection.

pushed.fact: Affected non-core candidate count increments without testing actual displacement; live text calls it 推开.

preview.fact: Preview uses actual configured sector and active-world wall intersections.

damage.fact: Common host path accepts actual HP loss and records protocol/root/target metadata.

failure.fact: Distinct player/vitality/infection checks are terminal before healing, travel and retest.

pressure.fact: Actual warning, organ drain, infection drift and critical timer logic.

campaign.fact: Route decisions change retained/new sources and organ pressure.

migration.fact: Real exit, unique migration, deadlines, compensation and actual interception checks.

travel.fact: Accepted travel preserves arenas and global cooldowns; no midrun save restoration.

background.fact: Cumulative offscreen grace, finite interval and per-trip damage budget.

objectives.fact: Objective/event gates, not survival clock, unlock the actual core.

retest.fact: Actual core clear, active-organ health, infection, player and vitality thresholds.

lung.fact: Breath phases produce real mass-specific movement.

airway.fact: Actual route and flow change, lung cost, cooldown and visible explanation.

lungVisual.fact: Visible flow samples the same physical vector function, with independent organ shapes.

landscape.fact: Heart/lung organ-specific landmarks and palettes exist.

camera.fact: One camera projection and scale pipeline is shared by organs.

core.fact: Real trait attacks, serialized warning shapes, membrane turns and cleanup.

battleVisual.fact: Trait silhouettes use structural non-color cues.

encounterVisual.fact: Accepted crisis source/target path/countdown cues remain in low effects.

renderer.fact: Low-effects modifies optional rendering, not combat state.

tactical.fact: Finite event-specific review records and critical message priorities.

history.fact: Critical causes are visible in player-facing history.

campaignHud.fact: Objective, organ-map risk, migration destination/deadline and consequences are visible.

encounterHud.fact: First-counter hints are in-game, but no source can prove player understanding.

plansCss.fact: Scrollable body and separate fixed footer keep plan actions reachable.

profile.fact: Terminal result validation, global ID ledger, bounded recent results and discoveries.

parse.fact: Versioned whitelist-only archive parsing and safe missing/invalid handling.

advice.fact: Deterministic suggestion branches use result/choice/action/equipment facts with a separate evidence sentence.

summary.fact: Seed, actual protocols, two-sided route and accepted metrics are recorded.

runOptions.fact: Replay uses frozen original preparation/guide config, legacy missing preparation becomes field.

resultHud.fact: Result displays next-attempt suggestion and its 本局依据.

main.fact: New case changes seed; retry retains current options and starts isolated state.

metrics.fact: Protocol logs count only with matching same-tick accepted positive loss; attempts are not hits.

units.scope: All non-batch units recorded on C; many deliberately use mechanism/terminal fixtures, not browser wins.

sim.scope: 1000 formal TypeScript input sessions; no research API, no archive unlock sequence, no render/native-input evidence.

functional.scope: Only two preparation and two directed-research cases. Every route is block; not the entire historical E2E suite.

prep.scope: Two independent fresh profiles, two actual wins each, plans/budget, accepted counters, saved replay and current retry.

performance.scope: Finite600.1667 simulated-second heart pressure, about300 seconds each mode; not exact100 simultaneous clear burst or lung-specific180 seconds.
